scope: Classic browser presentation now owns a real shared document/session, tool state machines, command rasterization, selection and history. Supported tools: pencil, round/square brush, opaque-ground eraser, fill, line/rectangle/ellipse; Shift constraints, Ctrl/Cmd-scroll zoom, clear and undo/redo. Layers can be added/selected/hidden/reordered/deleted.
files: Browser picker opens PCND/PNG/BMP/JPEG. Image import losses require acknowledgement. Save/Save as request an editable PCND download. Export requests a PNG after explicit flattening confirmation. New/Open protect dirty work; cancellation/failure retains the current session. Downloads never acknowledge confirmed disk persistence or clear dirty state. Before-unload confirmation is browser-policy controlled and is not recovery.
architecture: Raster command preparation moved into paintcraft-tools and is shared with desktop. Native Zstandard history and native filesystem save/recovery services remain outside the wasm dependency graph. Browser history currently uses raw snapshots; LZ4 is also portable. No fork of the desktop controller or native dialog service is used.
limits: Synchronous browser adapter: canvas <=4,194,304 pixels, strokes <=8192 points (exceeding cancels), history retention budget 64 MiB with old-entry trimming, input/project output <=64 MiB, private staged tile budget 16,777,216 pixels. These are logical admission limits, not an allocator-enforced physical memory bound or measured latency qualification. Document composition is CPU; wgpu/WebGPU/WebGL present the UI.

checks.web: 12 unit/UI integration tests plus 1 external UI test passed; includes preview/release equality for six tools, independent opaque eraser pixels, selection clipping, atomic denied staging, undo/redo, Escape/pointer-loss, New discard/cancel, layer retargeting, zoom and PNG export confirmation.
checks.formats: 69 tests passed, 1 subprocess helper ignored. New host limits reject oversized canvases/decodes and denied tile staging, preserving the default reader contract.
checks.history: 12 native history tests passed, including Zstandard/LZ4 bounded and corrupt-frame behavior after codec isolation.
checks.desktop: 94 desktop controller tests passed, 2 ignored, after shared command extraction.
checks.static: Strict workspace all-target Clippy, final web all-target Clippy and final wasm32 Clippy passed. Source length, formatting, whitespace and JavaScript syntax checks passed.
checks.build: Final optimized wasm bundle and wasm-bindgen generation passed.
checks.browser: Isolated headless Brave on one Mac with WebGPU enabled. Initial drawing sample had byte-identical captured canvas crops while held/after release, Undo restored blank pixels and dirty state, and no uncaught JavaScript errors. Final file sample downloaded a real PCND, kept the session dirty, successfully undid after dialog close, imported a 320x200 PNG and reopened the painted 1000x486 project. File chooser interception supplies smoke fixtures; this is not physical chooser/device qualification. PNG export has host codec and GUI confirmation coverage; its browser download was not separately exercised.

remaining: Editable text and shaping, image transforms, custom color/canvas property dialogs, additional brushes/shapes/view actions and frontend switching.
Browser workers, large-document resource/cancellation qualification, storage/recovery, confirmed durable browser saves, clipboard and actual GPU document composition.

Cross-browser/native-equivalent conformance fixtures, interruption matrix, IME, tablet/touch/pressure/tilt, WebGL fallback and device/accessibility qualification. T22 conformance remains not-started and T15 remains partial.
